ñāṇasutta: [Ñāṇa+sutta]  CL=7 (1)The discourse on wisdom states: that this dhamma is vedanā (suffering or feeling). (A) This dhamma is the cause of vedanā. (B) This dhamma is the practice (behavior) that leads to the arising of vedanā. (C) This dhamma is the cessation of vedanā. (D) This dhamma is the path that leads to the cessation of vedanā. (E) This dhamma reveals the bliss (freedom) from vedanā. (F) This dhamma is the discernment of the danger (defilements) in vedanā. (G) This dhamma is the liberation from vedanā, understood through the wisdom eye (ñāṇa-cakkhu). This wisdom-eye has now arisen within the Lord Buddha and has been realized. (2) The discourse on wisdom further states: (A) This dhamma arises dependent on chanda (skillful desire), which forms the basis for success (iddhipāda) when supported by samādhi (concentration) and vīriya (effort). (B) This dhamma arises dependent on citta (mindfulness or intention), which forms the basis for success (iddhipāda) when supported by samādhi (concentration) and vīriya (effort). (C) This dhamma arises dependent on vīriya (effort), which forms the basis for success (iddhipāda) when supported by samādhi (concentration) and vīriya (effort). (D) This dhamma arises dependent on paññā (wisdom), which forms the basis for success (iddhipāda) when supported by samādhi (concentration) and vīriya (effort). The Lord Buddha teaches that the cultivation and realization of these four dhammas lead to wisdom. This wisdom has now arisen within the Lord Buddha and has been realized.

ñāṇavatthusutta:
[Ñāṇavatthu+sutta]  CL=9 (A) The Four Kinds of Knowledge regarding Aging and Death (Jarāmaraṇa):
1. Knowledge of aging and death (jarāmaraṇa)
2. Knowledge of the origin/cause of aging and death (jarāmaraṇasamudaya)
3. Knowledge of the cessation of aging and death (jarāmaraṇanirodha)
4. Knowledge of the path leading to the cessation of aging and death (jarāmaraṇanirodhagāminīpaṭipadā)
(B) The Four Kinds of Knowledge regarding Rebirth-linking (Paṭisandhi):
1. Knowledge that in the present time, aging and death occur due to rebirth-linking
2. Knowledge that without rebirth-linking, there would be no aging and death
3. Knowledge that in the past time too, aging and death occurred due to rebirth-linking
4. Knowledge that without rebirth-linking, there would have been no aging and death
